name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the oldest merged PR first. It’s the fastest way to validate the tool’s accuracy against real, past decisions where we already know the outcome. The trade-off is delayed feedback on newer work, but speed here reduces risk of bad patterns spreading before we catch them.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the oldest merged PR risks exposing *new* edge cases that could break the tool’s assumptions—patterns we’ve since fixed or deprecated. Instead, run it on the *newest* merged PR where the tool’s rules are still current; that tests its accuracy against the latest decisions without gambling on stale code. Settle it by measuring its false-positive rate on both PRs—if the newest one shows fewer surprises, the argument is settled.
